cohort: The cohort consisted of 2533 singleton deliveries from 2015 to 2017 with available early second-trimester biomarker data and pregnancy outcomes.
finding: Serum uE3 demonstrated superior predictive performance for adverse fetal growth outcomes (AFGO) compared to fb-hCG and AFP, and machine learning models (GBM, GLM) significantly enhanced the prediction of small-for-gestational age (SGA).
